tip: Drop a control ward in the river brush before you recall so the lane keeps vision while you're away.
rationale: The reset window is when you're most exposed to a dive on return; a control ward denies the enemy the setup vision and keeps incoming ganks visible.
source_excerpt: Before you recall, place a control ward in the river brush to keep the lane warded while you reset.

tip: When the enemy botlane has both Flash and Exhaust up, give the wave instead of contesting it.
rationale: Two live defensive summoners let them win the all-in or survive a punish, so contesting the wave is negative-EV until one of those summoners is down.
source_excerpt: if they walk up with flash and exhaust up you just give the wave

tip: As Nautilus, don't walk up to trade while your Q (Dredge Line) is on cooldown -- your only engage and your only escape are gone.
rationale: Nautilus's entire threat is the hook; with it down an aggressive step has no follow-up and a punished return trade has no disengage.
source_excerpt: never walk up when your hook is down, it is your only engage and your only way out
